thread:
maria: Need to pick webinar topic by EOD Fri. Options: A) "Cut unit costs while keeping quality" (benchmarks + playbooks) B) "Latency wins: tactics for sub-100ms serving" C) "Enterprise routing + private deployments". Which pulls pipeline best?
aj: A and C split audience. A = higher volume signups, C = enterprise leads.
sam_k: A for sure. We can show Redwood Optimize numbers and a tiny config demo.
elaine: If A, speakers: Maria (product overview), Sam (benchmarks + demo clips), Ryan (customer snippet). Need a hostsomeone to keep pace 1. Aj can host?
aj: I can. Suggest format: 3 talks (10m each) + 15m panel + 10m Q&A. Short and actionable.
ryan: Customer is in for a short case; will provide anonymized metrics. Need speaker brief by Wed.
maria: Vote check: react with :thumbsup: to your preferred one-liner abstracts I dropped below.
maria: 1) "Cut inference unit costs without sacrificing quality: live benchmarks and config recipes"
maria: 2) "Practical inference optimizations: batching, caching, and quantization in production"
maria: 3) "Operationalizing LLMs: routing, fallbacks, and SLOs for reliability"
sam_k: :thumbsup: on 1. Very demoable.
aj: 2 nudges me but 1 is fine if we have crisp playbooks.
elaine: 1 aligns with marketing angle.
ryan: 1. I'll scrub numbers before slide upload.
maria: OK locked on 1. Ops: can we reserve greenroom + recording? @ops-bot schedule please.
ops-bot: Recording slot tentatively reserved 2026-04-14 10:00-11:30 PT. Greenroom 09:30-10:00 PT. Reply "confirm" to finalize.
aj: Confirm.
sam_k: Confirmed.
elaine: Confirmed.
ryan: Confirmed; customer slides by 4/10.

"09:50-10:00 greenroom
10:00-10:02 host intro
10:02-10:12 Maria: benchmark highlights (10m)
10:12-10:22 Sam: config playbook + short recorded demo (10m)
10:22-10:27 Ryan: customer case (5m)
10:27-10:35 Panel Q&A (8m)
10:35-10:40 Closing + CTA (5m)"
sam_k: I'll prepare two recorded clips: 60s dashboard highlight + 30s config before/after. Upload by 4/12.
elaine: I'll own speaker one-pagers and the social post bullets. Deliverable 4/9.
aj: Host script and 3 engagement prompts by Tue.
ryan: Legal wants some numbers anonymized; will do.
maria: Ops: add failover: if live demo stalls, cut to pre-record and jump to panel early. Panic channel = #release-war-room.
ops-bot: Failover rule added: if demo latency > 8s or token errors, auto-play clip, notify host, and post to panic channel.
maria: Final: everyone add 3 short takeaways (2-line social copy) + 1 suggested tweet by EOD Thu. We'll use these for launch posts and nurture.
elaine: Adding to calendar & will draft initial copy after speaker one-pagers.
sam_k: Noted; will share clip links here when uploaded.
maria: Thanks all 680. If no objections by EOD Fri we start promo next week.
